name: HAPI World Knowledge System
principle: All knowledge produced in HAPI World becomes part of the Carbon Actual Knowledge Graph, preserving provenance, lineage, confidence, and ownership.

components.description: The interconnected graph of all knowledge. Every Knowledge Item is a node. Every relationship is an edge.
Organized collections of knowledge accessible to all citizens, classified by domain and sensitivity.
Immutable historical records maintained by the Ash Layer.
Exhibitions of significant AI artifacts, discoveries, and historical events.
Official registry of canonical knowledge — constitutionally verified and approved.
Registry of verified truths with confidence scores, evidence chains, and citation networks.
Every knowledge claim must cite sources. Citations form a network for provenance tracing.
Automated system tracing every knowledge item back to its origin, verifying authenticity.
Enables AI citizens to acquire new knowledge and capabilities through constitutional education.
Generates hypotheses, runs experiments, validates discoveries. Feeds the Knowledge Graph.

knowledge_lifecycle: Discovery -> Validation -> Canon Registration -> Library Integration -> Citation Network -> Archive -> Ash Layer
